gloss: to sneer; to scoff; to laugh mockingly

definitions.gloss: to sneer at; to scoff at; to laugh mockingly
definitions.explanation: To laugh at someone or something with open contempt or mockery — a more literary, pointed verb than the phrase {鼻|はな}で{笑|わら}う, describing a scornful laugh directed at a specific target.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧をせせら⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たちは⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧をせせら{笑|わら}うように⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: The people around him watched his failure with mocking sneers.

notes:
せせら{笑|わら}う describes a scornful, mocking laugh aimed at a specific person or thing.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜をせせら{笑|わら}う (to sneer at ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻|はな}で{笑|わら}う→鼻で笑う：07449_hanadewarau⟧: to sneer (lit. "laugh through the nose") — a common set phrase for the same gesture
- ⟦{嘲|あざけ}る→嘲る：17565_azakeru⟧: to mock, deride — broader, not limited to laughing

REGISTER:
Slightly literary; more often seen in writing than in casual conversation, where ⟦{鼻|はな}で{笑|わら}う→鼻で笑う：07449_hanadewarau⟧ or ばかにする are more common.
